about: The first-period codes on the per-bar channel (coordinator ruling 2026-11-21, after #2280): request:htf-first-period-partial and request:htf-lookahead-first-period-partial write their bars to __withheldBars (sinkPerBar), so the vendor harness grades a bar withheld by name "not compared", never DIVERGE; a first-week value drawn wrong still DIVERGES. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the look-ahead-off first-period bars never written to the per-bar channel (graded DIVERGE again)
the look-ahead-on first-period bars never written to the per-bar channel
every bar written to the channel under the first-period code (a drawn bar hidden from the grade)
